headline: TTCL posts a 33.3% five‑day gain while TRITN plunges 33.3% over the same period.
market_take: The coverage universe showed mixed momentum. Construction stocks were split, with PLE up 14.29% intraday and TRITN down 33.33% after a price‑gap opening. Property saw strong divergence: JCK rallied 8.33% on heavy volume, whereas PF fell 20% on an open gap and KC dropped 33.33% on thin trading. Food remained volatile, highlighted by MADAME’s 10.84% rise and TWPC’s 14.6σ volume spike.

JCK jumped 8.33% on a 10.7σ volume spike; PF opened down 20% and KC fell 33.33% on low volume; EVER rose 16.67% with minimal trading.
PLE gained 14.29% intraday; TRITN suffered a 33.33% price‑gap drop; TRC showed a modest 3.3σ volume spike.
PPPM and NER each posted volume spikes above 3σ, indicating heightened activity.
